name: Language
description: How a file is read for what a person put in it.

scenarios.title: What a person wrote in a source file
given: a Ruby file carrying comments and identifiers
scenarios.when: the file is read for what a person wrote
scenarios.then: the comments answer and nothing else does

scenarios.title: A file no language claims
scenarios.when: the file is read for what a person wrote

scenarios.title: Nowhere for a claim to sit
scenarios.when: the file is read for where a claim could sit

scenarios.title: A file that declares nothing
scenarios.when: the file is read for what it declares

scenarios.title: Depth is not a barrier
given: a Ruby file whose claims sit in a class body, a method body and a block comment
scenarios.when: the file is read for where a claim could sit
scenarios.then: all of them answer, at whatever depth they sit

scenarios.title: A comment nothing follows
given: a Ruby file whose last line is a comment
scenarios.when: the file is read for where a claim could sit

scenarios.title: Source the grammar cannot read
given: a Ruby file the grammar cannot parse
scenarios.when: the file is read for where a claim could sit
scenarios.then: the file is named as unreadable rather than answering with what it recovered
